utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive's getting some attention. I'll keep an ear out for anything useful while I'm out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep listening while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything worth passing along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what time do I need to be there?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Come by at 6. I’ll have the tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll be there at 6.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, as far as I know. I’m just hoping the timing and supplies are all sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just checking that nothing’s slipped—are you sure the supplies are actually lined up?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I might’ve mixed up the time, but I’m happy to help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, Oren. Just come by when you can; I’ve got the supplies sorted and we’ll make it work.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, I’ll swing by when I can and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what the repair drive needs from me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it needs a few tools and some hands for the heavier stuff. I can check the list again if you want.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please check the list again so I don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — how can I help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks for jumping in, Dane. Could you help sort the donated items and check what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donations and check the list for anything we still need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus. I’ll help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll bring the tools and meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, I’ll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep an eye on where the repair drive gets dropped off. Where are they taking it?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I think they’re taking it to the community center on Maple. I can ask and make sure for you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Maple Community Center. I’ll keep that in mind and let you know if I hear anything else.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re still looking for volunteers, and the sign-up table’s at the community center today.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, and they said the center opens early, so it’s worth stopping by before noon if you want first pick of the jobs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think it starts at 9 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I'll be there at 9 a.m. Should I bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. I’ll tell Nell we’re on it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik. I’ll spread the word and keep an ear out for updates.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, I’ll keep Nell posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, I’ve got the repair drive list ready. Tell me what needs attention first, and I’ll keep track of the rest.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The front door sticks, and the hallway light keeps flickering. Those are the ones I’d start with.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Got it, I’ll put those at the top and keep the rest of the list moving.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive is still on for Saturday. I heard they’ve already got a stack of sign-ups, and they could use one more hand if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure, I can help with that Saturday. Just tell me what time to be there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Saturday at 9 a.m. works best, and I’ll make sure you know where to go when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late — what's left for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just the last few fixes and a quick sweep. We’re meeting by the garage at two to sort them out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll meet you by the garage at two and help finish the last fixes and sweep.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you want me to take a look.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: If you don’t mind, that would help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course, let me take a look.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I need the repair drive located at the east side of the lot, near the old tool shed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll head over to the east side by the old tool shed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, I can help spread the word about the repair drive if you want.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules. Can you check the date and location first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — I’ll check the date and location and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I missed the latest change, but I’m around if you need me to help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah. I’ll send you the latest update and can use a hand at the drive if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, I’m free and I’ll keep an eye out for your update.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is moving along, but I haven’t got the latest yet. If you’re heading over, I can ask around and see what’s changed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can do that. I’ll bring my drill and a few spare screws when I head over.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, that should help a lot. I’ll ask around and see if anything else has changed before you head over.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course, Leo. I can help with the repair drive if you tell me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — tell me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can start by checking the list of parts and seeing what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the timing and whether we have enough people to get it done without things getting messy.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We should line up a few more people before setting the date.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That makes sense. Let’s wait until we have enough people lined up so we don’t end up scrambling on the day.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Cleo, we’re putting together the repair drive this Saturday, and I’d love for you to come by and bring anyone who might want to help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, I’ll be there, and I can bring a few neighbors with tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thank you, Cleo. Bring whoever’s handy, and we’ll make sure there’s plenty to do on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I need to know when the repair drive is happening so I can work around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, I should pin that down. I’m thinking this Saturday morning, and I’ll confirm the exact time as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me, as long as you send me the exact time once it’s set so I can plan pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m on it, Nell. I’ll get the repair drive list updated and make sure we cover the urgent fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll keep an eye out for the urgent ones and check back when the list’s updated.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Nell. I’ll send the updated list over soon, and I’ll flag the urgent fixes first.
